description: This file defines an interface ICapture and its nested IStore within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace. It declares functionalities related to capturing screen data, including an interface for storing captured data and methods for obtaining capture instances.

classes.name: ICapture
classes.description: An interface for capturing screen data, providing methods to get the name, perform capture with a storage interface, and access an instance of the capture interface.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the capture device or interface.

methods.name: Capture
methods.description: Performs the capture operation, storing the result via the provided IStore object.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Provides access to a singleton instance of ICapture.

nested_classes.name: IStore
nested_classes.description: Interface for storing captured screen data in specific formats.

ctags.name: ICapture
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL ICapture : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
